questions.prompt: How did James become interested in trees?
questions.explanation: A friend of his mother who cared for trees offered him a summer job. This work sparked his interest, rather than climbing trees as a child.
questions.evidence: Mom had a friend who was an arborist – someone who takes care of trees – and he offered me a job one summer.
